_comment: Read by curl-read-allow.py (same directory). A curl target URL auto-approves (no prompt) only if BOTH (1) its host is in allowedHosts AND (2) the allowPrefixes per-host filter passes. allowPrefixes maps a host to its allowed PATH prefixes: ["*"] (or an empty list) allows all paths on that host; otherwise the URL path must start with a listed prefix, e.g. "/my-org/". A host that is in allowedHosts but ABSENT from allowPrefixes is unrestricted (the host gate still applies). To scope a site, replace its ["*"] with specific path prefixes. allowedHosts match is case-insensitive/exact ('.host' = subdomain wildcard); allowPrefixes host keys honor the same wildcard.
